Activation without a network: the request code as text and a QR code, then a response file loaded, dropped or pasted. A response whose signature does not verify is rejected with its reason, never silently.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    **Drop-in.** `offline-request` (the request code, and a half-block QR at 70 columns and 20 rows or more) and `import-bundle <file | ->`.

    **Styled part.** `screens.offline_activation(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `OfflineView` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.
